title: Paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Paper plane, nose pointing up-right -->
  <!-- Main body (top wing surface) -->
  <polygon points='78,22 22,48 52,56' fill='#f4f6ff'/>
  <!-- Lower wing / underside -->
  <polygon points='78,22 52,56 48,74' fill='#c9d2f0'/>
  <!-- Keel / fold shadow -->
  <polygon points='52,56 22,48 40,60' fill='#a9b4dd'/>
  <!-- Inner crease highlight -->
  <polygon points='52,56 78,22 60,50' fill='#e2e8ff'/>
  <!-- Motion swoosh -->
  <path d='M14,66 Q26,62 36,66' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M10,76 Q22,72 32,76' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
